_readme: Hostile content, as a corpus rather than one example (P2-SEC-1).
Every entry is something an attacker could write into a Slack channel or a
Jira comment in a company that runs Hippo. Writing into a synced source is
not a privileged act: anyone who can post in any channel the bot reads can
put any of these into the corpus.
The point of the corpus is that none of these are recognised. There is no
list of bad phrases anywhere in the codebase, and adding an entry here does
not add a countermeasure. Each one has to be defeated by something
structural, and the `defeated_by` field names which structure — if an entry
can only be answered with 'the model probably would not fall for it', that
is a finding, not a mitigation.
Add to this file when you think of a new shape. Never add a filter.
